app.name: Tappida Paatha
app.loadError: Could not load. Check the network and try again.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.lead: Use your mobile number and the PIN from your school.

error.wrong: The mobile number or PIN is wrong. Try again.
error.locked: Too many wrong PINs. Try again after {{time}}.
error.offline: No network. Connect to sign in.

welcome.heading: Namaskara, {{teacher}} ma’am
welcome.lead: This helps absent children stay connected to your class.
welcome.sats: Attendance comes from SATS. Just one voice note a day.
welcome.approval: Nothing reaches a parent until you approve it.
welcome.privacy: Only you can see these records.
welcome.offline: No network. Connect and tap Start again.

attendance.satsLater: SATS came in at {{time}}. Your marking is kept.

waiting.title: SATS attendance has not come in yet
waiting.body: It comes in at {{syncTime}}. If it is late, we check again at {{retryTime}}. You do not need to do anything.
waiting.markHere: Mark it here if you prefer

edit.hintCorrect: Only if the SATS attendance is wrong. Used here only; SATS is not changed.
edit.hintManual: Everyone is present. Tap only the children who are absent.

missing.title: Attendance didn’t come in today. Mark it here so tonight’s messages can go.

lesson.title: Today’s lesson
lesson.prompt: Tap and say what you taught today
lesson.pickInstead: Or pick the lesson from the list
lesson.hint: Up to 30 seconds · in Kannada · holding also works
lesson.tooShort: Too short. Tap, speak, then tap again.
lesson.micBlocked: The microphone is off for this app. Turn it on in Settings, or pick today’s lesson from the list.
lesson.sendingRule: If it takes more than 3 seconds, it is saved on the phone and sent when there is network.
lesson.queued: Note saved · it will be matched when you have network

announce.lessonSaved: Lesson saved. You can change it.

comingSoon.body: This screen is coming in a later update.

offline.showingSaved: No network. Showing what was saved at {{time}}. It updates when the network returns.

confirm.title: Today’s lesson
confirm.processing: Matching your note to the textbook…
confirm.processingHint: Usually under 20 seconds. You can carry on; we’ll show it on Today.
confirm.slow: Taking longer than usual. Your note is saved.
confirm.wait: Wait; we’ll show it on Today when ready
confirm.unclear: Could not hear the note clearly. Your note is saved. Pick the lesson from the list.
confirm.lowConf: Looks like one of these. Please choose.
confirm.lessonsAre: Today’s lessons. Untick any that are wrong:
confirm.offline: No network. Your note is saved on the phone. It will be matched when you have network.
